{{Short description|Polish physicist}}
'''Paweł Horodecki'''<ref>{{Cite web
| title = Gdansk University of Technology, Faculty of Applied Physics and Mathematics
| accessdate = 2011-02-28
| url = https://aqualung.mif.pg.gda.pl/index.php?mod=9&s=29&lang=en
| archive-date = 2006-09-30
| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20060930172748/http://aqualung.mif.pg.gda.pl/index.php?mod=9&lang=en&s=29
| url-status = live
}}</ref> (born 1971) is a Polish professor of [[physics]] at the [[Gdańsk University of Technology]] working in the field of [[quantum information theory]].<ref>{{Cite web
| title = Pawel Horodecki - publications list 
| accessdate = 2011-12-14
| url = https://arxiv.org/find/all/1/all:+AND+pawel+Horodecki/0/1/0/all/0/1
}}</ref>

He is best known for introducing (together with his father [[Ryszard Horodecki]] and brother [[Michał Horodecki]]) the [[Peres–Horodecki criterion]] for testing whether a quantum state is entangled.<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Horodecki|first1=Michał|last2=Horodecki|first2=Paweł|last3=Horodecki|first3=Ryszard|date=1996|title=Separability of mixed states: necessary and sufficient conditions|url=https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/S0375960196007062|journal=Physics Letters A|language=en|volume=223|issue=1–2|pages=1–8|doi=10.1016/S0375-9601(96)00706-2|arxiv=quant-ph/9605038|bibcode=1996PhLA..223....1H |s2cid=10580997 }}</ref> Moreover, Paweł Horodecki demonstrated that there exist states which are entangled whereas no pure entangled states can be obtained from them by means of local operations and classical communication ([[LOCC]]). Such states are called [[bound entanglement|bound entangled]] states.<ref>{{Cite web
| title = Ryszard Horodecki, Pawel Horodecki, Michal Horodecki, Karol Horodecki - Quantum entanglement 
| accessdate = 2011-05-22
| url = https://arxiv.org/PS_cache/quant-ph/pdf/0702/0702225v2.pdf
}}</ref>
He also showed that even bound entanglement (when used in conjunction with a single pair of free entangled particles) can lead to [[quantum teleportation]] with a [[Fidelity of quantum states|fidelity]] impossible to achieve with only separable states.<ref>{{Cite journal
| title = Pawel Horodecki - Bound Entanglement Can Be Activated
| journal = Physical Review Letters
| date = February 1999
| volume = 82
| issue = 5
| pages = 1056–1059
| doi = 10.1103/PhysRevLett.82.1056
| accessdate = 2011-12-14
| url = http://prl.aps.org/abstract/PRL/v82/i5/p1056_1
| last1 = Horodecki
| first1 = Paweł
| last2 = Horodecki
| first2 = Michał
| last3 = Horodecki
| first3 = Ryszard
| arxiv = quant-ph/9806058
| s2cid = 119390324
}}</ref>

Paweł Horodecki was educated in Poland, receiving an M.Sc from the [[University of Gdańsk]] (1995) and a Ph.D (with honours) from the [[Gdańsk University of Technology]] (1999) and a [[habilitation]] (with honours) from the [[University of Gdańsk]] (2004).
